name: service-handover
title: Service ownership handover
for_each: select id,code from services where lifecycle<>'retired' order by code

sections.title: Standards evidence
sections.sql: select standard,result,checked_on,evidence,has_exception from scorecard where service_id=$1 order by standard

sections.title: Open remediation
sections.sql: select code,title,owner,due_on from tasks where service_id=$1 and status='open' order by due_on

name: exception-record
title: Standards exception record
for_each: select id,code from exceptions order by code

sections.title: Decision record
sections.sql: select e.code,s.code as service,st.code as standard,e.reason,e.approver,e.expires_on,e.closed from exceptions e join services s on s.id=e.service_id join standards st on st.id=e.standard_id where e.id=$1

name: team-review
title: Team service review
for_each: select id,code from teams order by code

sections.title: Owned services
sections.sql: select code,name,lifecycle,tier,reviewed_on from services where team_id=$1 order by code

sections.title: Overdue tasks
sections.sql: select t.code,s.code as service,t.title,t.owner,t.due_on from tasks t join services s on s.id=t.service_id where s.team_id=$1 and t.status='open' and t.due_on<current_date order by t.due_on
